title: Musical stones and chimes
description: Turn objects (standing stones, bells, flowers) into an instrument: each sings a pentatonic note when the player passes, and several in a row sing a chord. Component: 3d/godot/world_life/proximity_notes.gd (world-life module). Derived from ShammyVerse.

optional_ai: Wiring the component into the game; a person reviews the result in play.

godot.title: Godot 4 console executable (Movie Maker)
godot.notes: Movie Maker records at the window size; the tool applies the resolution through a temporary override.cfg.

project_folder.title: Godot project folder
project_folder.help: The game's folder that contains project.godot. The world-life module is vendored into addons/gamecore_world_life/.

godot_executable.title: Godot console executable
godot_executable.help: Exact engine build used for capture (Godot_*_console.exe on Windows); recorded in the production record.

stages.title: Vendor the world-life module
stages.description: Copy the kit and components into the game with a SHA-256 lock per file.

stages.title: Wire the component
stages.description: Game code: Place the objects (an arc along a shore works well) and list them in `objects`. Leave `notes` empty for C-major pentatonic, or set frequencies. Sounds are synthesised at load time. Connect `sang(index)` to a glow or ring and `chord_played()` to a bigger effect. `radius`, `cooldown`, `chord_count`, `chord_window`, `volume_db`.

stages.title: Test
stages.description: Headless test on a fixed clock (the GameCore component test, plus the game's own).

checks.title: Passing three objects quickly plays a chord

stages.title: Review in play
stages.description: The requester reviews the result in play or in a showcase shot; notes go to the design log.

checks.title: Notes and chord sound pleasant at the effects volume

steps.title: Choose the game
steps.summary: Godot project and engine; the world-life module is vendored with a lock.

steps.title: Wire and test
steps.summary: Connect the component to the game and run the tests.
